changeSet.author: dabai
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, 0, 'AI智能', 'ai_management', 1, '/ai', 'Layout', NULL, 'Cpu', 4, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'ai_management');

INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'ai_management' LIMIT 1), 'AI对话', 'ai_chat', 2, '/ai/chat', 'ai/ChatView', 'ai:chat:list', 'ChatLineRound', 1, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'ai_chat');

INSERT INTO sys_menu (id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_code, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_menu), 0) + 1, (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'ai_management' LIMIT 1), 'AI配置', 'ai_config', 2, '/ai/config', 'ai/AiConfigManagement', 'ai:config:list', 'Setting', 2, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'ai_config');

INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (role_id, menu_id) SELECT 1, id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code IN ('ai_management', 'ai_chat', 'ai_config') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = 1 AND menu_id = sys_menu.id);
